identity_anchors: Large mixed-breed dog, St. Bernard sire and Scotch shepherd dam; 140 lb prime weight later starved to 115 then recovered near 150; broad-breasted, long-furred, white-fanged; muzzle long and wolf-like but oversized, head broader massive wolf scale; stray brown on muzzle and above eyes, white splash mid-chest; coat can show silk sheen or hang limp draggled matted with blood; muscles hard iron rolls under skin when fit
source_evidence: Weighed only one hundred and forty pounds; father huge St. Bernard Elmo, mother Scotch shepherd Shep; later one hundred and fifteen; one hundred and fifty pounds grit and virility; furry coat shone with sheen of silk; mane half bristled; brown on muzzle and above eyes, splash of white hair midmost down chest; muzzle long wolf muzzle larger, head somewhat broader wolf head on massive scale
voice_label: deep resonant bark / wolf howl / low growl

wardrobe_variants.description: Full glossy coat, clean, no harness; brass collar later filed off
source_facts: lived life of sated aristocrat
beautiful coat
heavy brass collar
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Sun-warmed healthy sheen, proud carriage, no trail wear

wardrobe_variants.description: Coat flecked bloody slaver, eyes blood-shot, tongue swollen; no collar
source_facts: blood flowing from nose mouth ears
beautiful coat sprayed and flecked with bloody slaver
eyes turned blood-shot
parched and swollen throat and tongue
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Matted fury, foam, raw neck after collar removal

wardrobe_variants.description: Working sled harness of straps and buckles; coat hardens, feet may wear moccasins temporarily
source_facts: arrangement of straps and buckles
harness
Francois sacrificed tops of moccasins to make four moccasins for Buck
muscles became hard as iron
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Practical northern trace gear, progressive trail grime and ice between toes

wardrobe_variants.description: Coat limp draggled or matted dried blood; muscles wasted to knotty strings; ribs and bones outlined through loose wrinkled hide; 115 lb
source_facts: one hundred and forty pounds had dwindled to one hundred and fifteen
hair hung down limp and draggled or matted with dried blood
muscles wasted away to knotty strings
flesh pads disappeared
each rib and every bone outlined cleanly through loose hide wrinkled in folds of emptiness
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Emaciated walking skeleton under Hal's club marks

wardrobe_variants.description: Recovered full coat silk sheen, heavy mane, perfect condition no superfluous flesh; later scarred by many dog teeth
source_facts: muscles swelled out flesh came back
in perfect condition without ounce of superfluous flesh
furry coat shone with sheen of silk
face and body scored by teeth of many dogs
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Glorious virile northern dog, love-bond posture softens only for Thornton

wardrobe_variants.description: Gigantic wolf-like form, brown muzzle splashes and white chest rift retained; coat glorious; runs at pack head
source_facts: great gloriously coated wolf like and yet unlike all other wolves
splashes of brown on head and muzzle rift of white centring down the chest
leaping gigantic above his fellows
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Legendary night silhouette under moon or borealis, throat a-bellow
